candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is uniform and clean across all views, with sharp edges and clear hardware definition in the detail block.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing broad paint retention with irregular edge corrosion and downward rust runs, though the top surface dust is slightly patchy.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a consistent matte grey-green finish with clean, well-defined panel lines and hardware.

locker_aged.explanation: The aged locker displays realistic weathering with significant edge wear and rust streaking that matches the brief's requirements.

grey-green_paint.observations: The base color is a consistent desaturated grey-green across both candidate and reference objects in the as-built state.

bare_hardware.observations: Handles and fixtures appear as distinct metallic elements that contrast with the painted surfaces in the detail view.

dark_trim.observations: Dark accents are visible on the drawer fronts and locker base in the as-built state.

edge_corrosion.observations: The aged state shows concentrated rust and paint loss along the vertical edges and corners of the furniture.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow, vertical rust streaks are clearly visible on the front faces of the aged candidate and locker.

settled_dust.observations: A soft, light-colored overlay is present on the top surfaces of the aged objects, simulating fine dust.

faded_fabric.observations: No fabric pads are visible on the shown furniture pieces.

findings: The dust on the top surface of the aged candidate in the top block appears slightly more mottled than the reference locker.
The rust runs on the candidate's front face are slightly more prominent than on the reference locker, though still within acceptable range.
limitations: The orthographic views make it difficult to judge the exact depth of the corrosion relief.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected
